title: Gumdrop Summer
blurb: Milky ribbon, summer triangle, candy-colored wonder.
whisper_start: Summer glass is sticky-sweet. Glide the triangle. Catch the gumdrop glows.

pins.label: Porch star
pins.note: Altair — the bright porch light of summer. Wave at the dogs.

pins.label: Lantern
pins.note: Vega again, but warmer. Name one summer sound.

pins.label: Dragon tail
pins.note: Deneb — far and soft. The ribbon stretches.

drift_mysteries.story_hook: A gumdrop spark between porch and lantern…
Candy-colored dust off the summer triangle.

mystery.story_hook: The gumdrop itself — unlabeled. Press P and claim the sweet.
